settings_description: Change how Orbs looks, connects and runs your bots.
settings_gifs_credit: Animated emoji by Google Noto, CC BY 4.0. Anime reactions from otakugifs.xyz.
settings_theme_import_hint: Paste shadcn theme CSS with :root and .dark sections. Colors and corner radius are imported; other styles are ignored.
settings_theme_preview_reply: Here is a preview of your conversation.
settings_theme_values_error: Use valid colors and a corner radius. Both modes need supported theme variables.
settings_theme_storage_error: The theme could not be saved on this device. Check that browser storage is available.
settings_models_empty: Create a bot to manage its model here.
settings_models_replace_hint: Only bots still using this model will change. Active replies finish with their current model. A fallback using the same model shares the primary reasoning level.
settings_models_save_error: Could not replace the models. Check that the new model is available and try again.
settings_chat_enter_mobile: Return key on a phone or tablet
settings_secrets_empty: No secrets yet. A bot asks for one when it needs it.
settings_secrets_mode_hint: Proxies keep real keys hidden from bots.
settings_tools_rules_when_placeholder: When a bot wants to… e.g. send emails for me
settings_tools_timeout_hint: With no answer in time, the tool call is denied.
settings_secret_saved: Saved. Type a new value to replace it.
settings_save_error: Settings were not saved. Try again.
settings_paths_error: This list was not saved. Try again.
settings_devices_revoke_error: The device was not removed. Try again.
settings_devices_revoke_description: This device loses access right away. Pair it again to use it.
settings_devices_pair_error: No pairing PIN was created. Try again.
settings_devices_pair_empty_description: Create a PIN here, then enter it or scan the code on the device you want to add.
settings_devices_pair_ready: Enter this PIN on the new device within 5 minutes, or scan the code.
settings_devices_scan_description: Scan a pairing code from another {name} server. This phone then leaves the current server.
settings_providers_sign_out_description: Bots that use {provider} stop answering until you sign in again.
settings_providers_error: The provider did not respond. Try again.
settings_providers_login_command: Sign in from a terminal on the server:
settings_server_description: Devices try these addresses in order and use the first one that answers.
settings_server_error: The address was not saved. Try again.
settings_mcp_callback_connected_body: You can close this window. The MCP server is ready for your bot.
settings_mcp_callback_failed_body: Something went wrong while signing in. Close this window and try again from the app.
settings_mcp_callback_expired_body: This login link expired or was already used. Start the login again from the app.
settings_general_hint: Notifications, what the chat shows, and how Orbs looks.
settings_models_hint: Sign in to model providers, and change the models your bots use.
settings_tools_hint: What bots may run on their own, and when they ask you first.
settings_secrets_hint: Keys and passwords bots can use without seeing them.
settings_sources_hint: Where bots load skills, instructions, plugins and MCP servers from.
settings_server_hint: The addresses your devices use to reach this server.
settings_devices_hint: Phones and computers that can use this server.
settings_desktop_hint: How the Mac app shares this server on your network.
settings_chat_hint: What the Enter key does, and what happens when you write while a bot works.
